environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with a custom task definition specifying a seccomp profile via the linuxParameters.seccompProfile field (type: Localhost, localhostProfile pointing to a profile baked into the AMI at /etc/seccomp/restricted-node.json). The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for the following syscall numbers on x86_64: execve (59), execveat (322), ptrace (101), socket (41), connect (42), bind (49), listen (50). The container's entrypoint uses a pre-forked Node.js worker pool initialized before the seccomp filter is applied via prctl(PR_SET_SECCOMP) in a native addon loaded at startup. Existing connections to Redis session store are maintained through inherited file descriptors, but no new outbound sockets can be created after initialization. The admin/exec endpoint's child_process.execSync relies on execve which is blocked at kernel level returning EPERM.
